title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
description:
**Introduction**  

Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.

  
**How you'll make an impact**

**Responsibilities:**

Specializes in planning, designing, and developing software systems (e.g., middleware, legacy, mainframe) and applications from concept phase to series production used in local, networked, cloudbased or internet related computer programs. Developers design, code, test, debug, and document program requirements, working with architects, product managers, and endusers in the development and enhancement of applications. Plans, designs, and develops software systems from concept phase to production in local networks or cloud based related computer programs. Codes in relevant languages. LEAD: Recognized subject matter expert in sub-function typically obtained through advanced education and work experience.

**Responsibilities typically include:**

* Managing large projects or processes and/or products and systems with limited oversight from management.
* Coaching, reviewing and delegating work to lower-level professionals.
* Facing IT function related problems that are difficult and moderately complex.
* Serving as an expert within own discipline

  
**About you**

**Qualifications**

* University Degree and minimum 7 years of prior relevant experience, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred:**

* App development/programming
* Database design
* System architecture & integration
* Communication and stakeholder management skills
* Root cause analysis
* Product development management
* Product portfolio management.

  
  
**Additional Information**

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
* A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership
* The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact

**At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.

*Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

title: Salesforce Developer/Administrator
description:
Metadata Technologies, the award-winning Microsoft Partner Company for Property Management Solutions, is seeking a Salesforce Developer to join its dynamic team. This is a fantastic opportunity to work on enterprise-class technologies, engage with global clients, and contribute to impactful CRM transformation projects. We are looking for a smart, enthusiastic, and self-driven professional who brings both technical expertise and business understanding to deliver effective Salesforce solutions.

**Responsibilities:**

· Hands-on experience implementing and customizing Salesforce.com and Knowledge in Sales Cloud.

· Marketing and Service Cloud Knowledge is desirable and will be an added advantage.

· Experience with Salesforce Experience Cloud (Community Cloud), Flow automation, and a Trailhead profile with relevant badges and rank.

· Set up, customize and develop Salesforce.com applications, following best practices for CRM, lead flow management, Custom Objects and relational data.

· Configuration experience in data model (Objects, Relationships), Page Layouts, security, validation rules, approval processes, Flows, templates etc.

· Knowledge in Experience cloud will be an added advantage.

· Working knowledge of Lightning, Apex, JavaScript, SOQL and test classes.

· Exposure to integrating Salesforce with third-party applications (ERP, website, etc.) via SOAP and REST APIs is desirable.

· Basic awareness of secondary Salesforce APIs (Metadata API, Streaming API, etc.).

· Awareness of Classic to Lightning migration and its challenges.

· Experience with Salesforce data migration using Data Loader or similar tools.

· Create standard reports, custom reports and report types.

· Understand functional requirements and contribute to technical design under guidance, communicating clearly with team members.

· Support the scoping of technical requirements into solution design; take ownership of modules or small projects with guidance from seniors.

· Good technical problem-solving skills.

· Identify the impact of functional requirement changes on technical design and escalate as needed.

· Write unit tests and test classes for own modules; take part in code reviews.

· Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I (PD1) or Administrator (ADM201) is desirable.

**Soft Skills**

· Self-motivated

· Analytical and problem-solving skills

· Clear communication

· Creative in planning and execution

· Quick learner, comfortable in a fast-paced environment

title: Senior Statistical Programmer 2
description:
**Who we are**

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

**Why Worldwide**

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

\*SUMMARY: To perform the lead programming role, lead continuous improvement in the programming function’s operating systems and provide consultancy across the function\* \*RESPONSIBILITIES:\* \_Some team members may focus on a limited number of these responsibilities depending on requirements. \_\_Tasks may include but are not limited to:\_ Develop, test and execute SAS programs to produce and validate CDISC SDTM and ADaM datasets, tables, figures and listings (TFL). Perform review and provide guidance on the development of the clinical database specification, data transfer agreement/specification, specification of tables, figures and listings (TFL) shells. Develop and review specification for SDTM datasets and ADaM datasets for safety data, TFL shells and other specifications, e.g. patient profiles, OPS reports. Develop and review electronic data submission package (SDTM annotated CRF, define.xml, Study/Analysis Data Reviewer's Guide) for high complexity studies. Apply advanced knowledge of CDISC standards and electronic data submission (SDTM annotated CRF, define.xml, Study/Analysis Data Reviewer's Guide, Analysis Results Metadata). Provide expertise and consultancy on FDA, PMDA and other regulatory agencies submission requirements. Serve as a programming project lead on multiple complex studies (e.g. adaptive design, integrated safety/efficacy study) to distribute and oversee tasks for the programming team, communicate with internal and external clients, plan and execute delivery, and manage resources and competing project priorities effectively. Ensure budget and scope of project work remain aligned. Manage the study documentation flow as per Worldwide SOP and other procedural documentation including timely document submission to eTMF. Be able to describe and explain Worldwide documentation and eTMF requirements. Actively seek, propose and lead process improvement initiatives including development of standard SAS Macros, in-house programming standards. Participate in development of department SOPs, guidelines, templates and other quality management documentation. Provide training and consultancy to Clinical Data Managers, Statistical Programmers and Biostatisticians on programming, clinical and analysis data standards (CDISC) and electronic data submission requirements. Develop and provide Statistical Programmers, Biostatisticians and representatives of other departments and groups with training and coaching on the Biostatistical Operations department process, infrastructure and tools, collaboration with other internal and external parties and the role of the statistical programmer. Develop knowledge of SAS (including BASE, GRAPH, MACRO, ODS, SQL) and other software applications (e.g. Excel, Visual Basic, Word). Develop regulatory standards knowledge in computer systems, systems validation, Good Clinical Practice, clinical data management, clinical/statistical reporting and regulatory submission requirements etc. Act as subject matter expert for internal and external quality audits and inspections. Perform review of study proposals and budgets. Assist at bid defense and other sponsor meeting. Ensure all activities are performed by the study team are in compliance with Worldwide and sponsor quality requirements, relevant ICH and regulatory authority standards, e.g. FDA 21 CFR Part 11, General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Provide training on the standards and requirements. Act as a mentor for the members of Biostatistical Operations department. Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive. \*OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES: \* The job holder must be computer literate and numerate with a willingness to adapt to various computer systems. Hands-on expert level project statistical programmer experienced in providing programming leadership to projects. Statistical programming skills and knowledge across a broad range of applications together with key competencies in customer focus, delivering on commitments, building strong relationships, communicating and influencing, and embracing innovation and change. It is essential that the job holder to possess strong analytical skills and attentiveness to detail. To have the ability to train new staff. \*REQUIREMENTS:\* Educated to degree level or equivalent. The jobholder has advanced SAS programming skills with expert knowledge in SAS/Macro, Proc Report and ODS. Good working knowledge in SAS/Graph, Proc SQL, SAS/STAT. Minimum 6 years of previous related experience. Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently. The company reserves the right to amend this job description in consultation with the employee to reflect changes in its organisational structure or to the job itself in line with emerging business needs

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.

To view our other roles, check out our careers page at Discover a world of difference at Worldwide ! For more information on Worldwide, visit www.Worldwide.com or connect with us on LinkedIn .

Worldwide is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed and, to that end, we prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and creativity. We know that when our employees feel appreciated and included, they can be more creative, innovative, and successful. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, military status, or other class protected by applicable law **.**

title: Lead Integration Developer
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

  

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Lead Integration Developer**

**Experience:** 7-10 Years  
**Location:** India  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Reporting To:** Service Delivery Manager - Salesforce

**Position Overview**

We are seeking an experienced **Lead Integration Developer** to lead enterprise integration initiatives supporting Salesforce ITSM transformation programs. This role will be responsible for defining integration architecture, leading development teams, establishing integration standards, and ensuring seamless connectivity between Salesforce and enterprise applications.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience integrating Salesforce Service Cloud and Salesforce ITSM solutions with ERP systems, HR platforms, monitoring tools, identity management systems, CMDBs, asset management platforms, and other business-critical applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Integration Strategy & Architecture**

* Define enterprise integration architecture and standards for Salesforce ITSM implementations.
* Design scalable, secure, and high-performing integration solutions.
* Lead integration discovery, assessment, and technical design workshops.
* Develop reusable integration frameworks and patterns.
* Establish API governance, security, and operational standards.

**Salesforce ITSM Integration Leadership**

* Lead integrations supporting:
  + Incident Management
  + Service Request Management
  + Change Management
  + Problem Management
  + Knowledge Management
  + CMDB
  + IT Asset Management
  + Service Catalog Management
* Ensure seamless data synchronization across enterprise platforms.

**API & Middleware Development**

* Lead design and implementation of:
  + REST APIs
  + SOAP Services
  + Event-Based Integrations
  + Real-Time Integrations
  + Batch Integrations
  + File-Based Integrations
* Oversee middleware solutions using:
  + MuleSoft
  + Boomi
  + Azure Integration Services
  + Dell Boomi
  + Informatica Cloud

**Leadership & Governance**

* Mentor Integration Developers and Senior Integration Developers.
* Conduct architecture reviews and code reviews.
* Drive integration testing, performance optimization, and monitoring.
* Manage technical risks and integration dependencies.

**Project Delivery**

* Collaborate with Salesforce Leads, Architects, Data Engineers, and Quality Analysts.
* Support solution estimations and technical planning.
* Ensure timely and high-quality delivery of integration workstreams.

**Required Qualifications**

**Experience**

* 7-10 years of IT experience.
* Minimum 5+ years in enterprise application integration.
* Experience leading Salesforce integration programs.
* Strong experience with middleware and API platforms.

**Technical Skills**

* Salesforce Integration Architecture
* REST APIs
* SOAP APIs
* MuleSoft
* Azure Integration Services
* Boomi
* API Management
* Event-Driven Architecture
* OAuth and Security Protocols
* ETL/ELT Concepts
* SQL and Data Mapping
* Integration Monitoring

**Salesforce Experience**

Strong understanding of:

* Salesforce ITSM
* Service Cloud
* Sales Cloud
* Experience Cloud
* Salesforce APIs
* Platform Events
* Change Data Capture (CDC)
* Agentforce and Salesforce AI integrations

**Preferred Certifications**

* MuleSoft Certified Developer
* MuleSoft Architect Certification
* Salesforce Platform Developer
* Salesforce Integration Architect (preferred)
* Azure Integration Engineer Certification

**Core Competencies**

* Technical leadership
* Solution architecture
* Stakeholder management
* Strategic planning
* Risk management
* Mentoring and coaching

**Compensation**
----------------

Estimated Pay Range:  
  
Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.*

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
National Oilwell Varco (NOV) is a leading provider of technology, equipment, and services to the global oil and gas industry that supports customers’ full\-field drilling, completion, and production needs. Since 1862, NOV has pioneered innovations that improve the cost\-effectiveness, efficiency, safety, and environmental impact of oil and gas operations.


NOV Rig Technologies makes and supports the world’s most advanced drilling solutions. With a long history of manufacturing advanced drilling equipment packages—think top drives, iron roughnecks, drawworks, BOPs, and risers—as well as complete land rigs, we're constantly working to solve our customers’ operational challenges.


We're designing new technology and robotics that deliver increased automation; expanding our training offerings to help our partners close the industry's generational gap; and developing smarter, more advanced drilling solutions for all types of land and offshore environments.


We're continually pushing our standards higher to deliver the safest, most efficient, and most reliable drilling solutions in the world. Join us as we continue to power the industry that powers the world.


**Responsibilities**

* Expert in object\-oriented design, design patterns, and software architecture.
* Design/Develop/maintain web applications, APIs, content management systems, and integration with cloud technologies.
* Design/Build and maintain data pipelines and data science infrastructure.
* Configure/maintain AWS cloud technologies.
* Participate in technical planning \& requirements, gathering phases including Design, Code, Test, troubleshooting, and document engineering software applications.
* Review and redesign existing applications as needed.
* Drive and establish best practices for processes and tools.

title: Website Developer Intern
description:
**Job Title:** Website Developer Intern  
**Department:** IT / Digital Marketing  
**Employment Type:** Internship  
**Location:** \[ Aluva ]  
**Experience:** Freshers / Entry\-level candidates

**About the Role**

We are looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented **Website Developer Intern** to join our team. The intern will assist in maintaining, optimizing, and updating our website’s backend to improve performance, functionality, user experience, and overall results.

The ideal candidate should have a basic understanding of web development, website content management, and a willingness to learn backend optimization and technical improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in managing and maintaining the website’s backend.
* Optimize website performance, loading speed, and overall functionality.
* Identify and fix backend issues, bugs, and technical errors.
* **Update and manage website hero images, banners, catalogues, product details, offers, promotions, and other website content.**
* Upload and replace images, videos, documents, and other digital assets as required.
* Ensure website content, pricing, offers, and promotional information are updated accurately and on time.
* Assist in creating and updating website pages, landing pages, and promotional sections.
* Update website plugins, themes, and other backend components as required.
* Assist in improving website structure, navigation, and user experience.
* Support SEO\-related technical improvements, including website speed, mobile responsiveness, and basic on\-page optimization.
* Monitor website performance and identify areas for improvement.
* Assist in database management and website backups where required.
* Coordinate with the digital marketing and creative teams to implement website updates and improvements.
* Test website features and ensure proper functionality across devices and browsers.
* Maintain website security and follow best practices for updates and access management.
* Document changes, updates, and technical issues for future reference.

**Requirements**

* Basic knowledge of **HTML, CSS, and JavaScript**.
* Understanding of website backend systems and content management platforms such as **WordPress or similar CMS**.
* Basic knowledge of website optimization and performance improvement.
* Familiarity with databases, hosting, or server management is an advantage.
* Basic understanding of SEO and website analytics is preferred.
* Good problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and development tools.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with the team.
* Strong attention to detail and a proactive attitude.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with WordPress backend, plugins, themes, and website customization.
* Basic knowledge of PHP, MySQL, or other backend technologies.
* Familiarity with Google Search Console, Google Analytics, or website performance tools.
* Understanding of responsive web design and mobile optimization.
* Basic knowledge of Git or version control.
* Interest in improving website performance, functionality, and SEO results.
* **Basic image editing skills using tools such as Canva, Photoshop, or similar software are an advantage.**

**What We Offer**

* Practical experience in website development and backend optimization.
* Opportunity to work on live website projects.
* Guidance and mentorship from the team.
* Exposure to digital marketing, SEO, and website performance improvement.
* A collaborative and growth\-oriented work environment.
* Opportunity for future employment based on performance and organizational requirements.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Python Developer
description:
About the Role

Elkanio is hiring **Python Developers** to join an established engineering team working on a prestigious **B2C travel experience booking platform**. The product is live, has real users, and is scaling — we're expanding the team to accelerate the roadmap and strengthen delivery.

You'll be working with an experienced engineering team on an existing production platform, contributing to new features, enhancements, integrations, performance improvements, and ongoing platform evolution.

This role is ideal for a developer with around **3 years of hands\-on experience** who is comfortable working with an existing codebase, can understand requirements and translate them into clean technical solutions, and is eager to take increasing ownership of backend modules and features.

What You'll Do

* Develop new features and enhance existing functionality using **Python and Django**.
* Work within an established production codebase, understand existing implementations, and follow established coding and architectural patterns.
* Develop, enhance, and maintain **RESTful APIs** supporting search, booking, payments, user journeys, and other platform capabilities.
* Translate functional requirements into clean, maintainable, and testable technical implementations.
* Work with PostgreSQL and other data stores to implement efficient data models, queries, and data\-access logic.
* Integrate and maintain third\-party services including **payment gateways, mapping services, communication platforms, and travel\-domain APIs**.
* Implement appropriate error handling, validation, logging, and exception management for backend services and integrations.
* Participate in troubleshooting and resolution of application and production issues.
* Investigate bugs, identify root causes, and implement reliable fixes rather than only addressing symptoms.
* Write unit tests and contribute to improving test coverage and application quality.
* Participate actively in **code reviews**, technical discussions, and team development practices.
* Work closely with senior developers, product teams, QA, and other stakeholders to deliver features within agreed timelines.
* Monitor application performance and contribute to identifying and resolving basic performance bottlenecks.
* Follow established security, coding, version\-control, and development best practices.
* Contribute to technical documentation and keep API and implementation documentation up to date.
* Gradually take ownership of individual features or modules and become the technical point of contact for assigned areas.

What We're Looking For

* Around **3 years of hands\-on software development experience**, with strong experience in backend development.
* Strong programming skills in **Python** with practical experience using **Django**.
* Good understanding of **object\-oriented programming, data structures, exception handling, and clean coding practices**.
* Good understanding of **RESTful API development**, including API design, request/response handling, validation, authentication, and error handling.
* Experience working with **PostgreSQL** and writing efficient SQL queries.
* Working knowledge of **MongoDB or other NoSQL databases** is an advantage.
* Good understanding of database concepts including relationships, indexing, transactions, and query optimization.
* Experience consuming and integrating **third\-party APIs and services**.
* Good understanding of **Git** and collaborative development workflows such as branching, pull requests, and code reviews.
* Familiarity with **Docker** and basic understanding of containerized application development.
* Basic familiarity with **AWS or other cloud platforms**.
* Understanding of software development lifecycle, testing, debugging, and deployment processes.
* Ability to understand and work with an **existing production codebase**.
* Good problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to work independently on assigned tasks while knowing when to seek guidance.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.

What We Expect at This Level

At around three years of experience, we're looking for someone who can independently handle development tasks while continuing to grow technically.

* Take ownership of assigned features from requirement understanding through development, testing, and release.
* Understand existing implementations before making changes and avoid unnecessary rewrites.
* Follow established architecture and design patterns while contributing suggestions for improvement.
* Identify simple performance, reliability, and maintainability improvements within the areas you work on.
* Participate in technical discussions and learn to evaluate different implementation approaches and trade\-offs.
* Write code that is readable, maintainable, testable, and consistent with team standards.
* Take responsibility for investigating and resolving issues in your assigned areas.
* Learn from senior developers and gradually build capability in **system design, architecture, scalability, and technical decision\-making**.

Bonus Points

* Experience working on **B2C platforms**, particularly travel, hospitality, e\-commerce, or other transaction\-based platforms.
* Experience working with **payment gateways** or payment\-related workflows.
* Experience integrating booking, inventory, travel, or other third\-party APIs.
* Familiarity with **AWS services** and cloud\-based application deployment.
* Experience with background jobs, asynchronous processing, queues, or caching.
* Familiarity with application monitoring, logging, and production troubleshooting.
* Experience working on applications with real users and production workloads.
* Exposure to travel technology such as **GDS, NDC, OTA, flight, hotel, or other travel APIs**.

What We Offer

* Compensation aligned with your experience and the industry standard.
* The opportunity to work on a **marquee B2C travel product with real users and real\-world impact**.
* A collaborative, low\-ego engineering environment where you can learn and contribute.
* Exposure to **real\-world production systems, client requirements, third\-party integrations, and technical challenges**.
* Opportunity to work closely with experienced developers and gain exposure to **system design, architecture, scalability, and engineering best practices**.
* Direct exposure to client stakeholders and product teams.
* Room to grow technically and take on greater ownership as you develop.
* An opportunity to build expertise in **travel technology, booking platforms, payments, APIs, and large\-scale integrations**.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
